programme.title: Sultan Mahmood Mangkat Dijulang

programme.title: Walid
programme.desc: Selepas rampasan kuasa, tatanan baharu terbentuk di Jihad Ummah. Habiburrahman mendakwa ketuhanan, memukau pengikut—namun janji penyelamatan menyembunyikan realiti yang lebih gelap.

programme.title: Cupcake Mama
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Hanna, isteri dan ibu yang bosan dengan rutin hidup. Dorongan keluarga membawa dia memulakan perniagaan cupcake dari rumah, sambil mengimbangi peranan sebagai isteri, ibu dan usahawan.

programme.title: Cinta Kita
programme.desc: Akibat dikecewakan lelaki, Tipah merubah ketrampilan menjadi Dino, tomboy yang kecelaruan identiti sehinggalah Man muncul menyelamatkan cintanya.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu
programme.desc: Demi seorang lelaki, Putri sanggup belajar main futsal. Filem remaja kontemporari lakonan Nur Fazura dan Sazzy Falak, Pelakon Wanita Pembantu Terbaik FFM19.

programme.title: Pintu Neraka

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Actress Lily Ho plays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senseless maiming and her mother's rape. 18 years later, it's payback time.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: 5 Shaolin rebels train hard in order to successfully defeat their Manchu enemies. Starring David Chiang, Ti Lung, Alexander Fu.

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: As the aggressive Chin Empire conquers the Chao Kingdom and drains the Wei empire, adventure, intrigue and tragedy abound as the armies march into battle.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A ruthless gang goes up against a millionaire's daughter who has one of three priceless Golden Buddha statues.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: A man on the run (Fu Sheng) learns that heroism is likely to lead to nihilistic desecration.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: Martial arts greats Lau Kar Leung and Alexander Fu play out the vendetta of General Yang and the creation of the unique eight-diagram pole fight technique.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Hsuan sets out to apprehend George Eaton, a high profile thug who has escaped to Hong Kong. With home support, can Yang take him down?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh joins forces with Ni Kuang and martial arts choreographer Liu Chia-liang to craft this brilliant saga from the golden age of kung fu films.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: Directed by Lee Han-hsiang and starring Michael Hui, this blockbuster confirms Hui's versatile talents as the king of comedy.

programme.title: Brothers From the Walled City
programme.desc: The lives of two very different brothers intertwine when they find themselves the target of a vengeful inspector.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Directed by Ho Meng Hua, this film depicts the currents that buoy two families, sweeping them toward revenge in the wake of an unexpected reunion.

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luk's directing debut.

programme.title: The Singing Escort

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: A pair of female martial artists end up banding together to go up against the evil Black Demon. Starring Cheng Pei Pei.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: The Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Havoc dogs a swordsman who uncovers a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased master.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies' sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: A gutsy lass (Kara Hui Ying-Hung) becomes a kung-fu family's matriarch so that its dastardly Third Uncle won't get the inheritance.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: While returning the stolen Golden Sword to the palace, a sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master, only to return as a spirit to take revenge against the evildoer.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by
programme.desc: A doctor falls for a schizophrenic old classmate he's treating who refuses to accept that her lover is dead.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: A hero (Chen Kuan Tai) battles assassins who use a deadly, beheading weapon to kill dissidents.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: This seminal film adaptation of a 17th century Pu Songling work is the precursor of the famed 'A Chinese Ghost Story'.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: This fascinating story of conflicting clans marks the beginning of Sun Chung's exploration of the kung fu genre.

programme.title: Man of Iron
programme.desc: In this fight-filled sequel, Chen Kuan-tai's character wins a bet against a gang leader's son. Soon, father and son are hot on his heels!

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Directed by the legendary Chang Cheh, this rousing tale presents a fictional account of the famous Italian explorer's adventures.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: This fascinating, humorous box office smash captures a cross-section of Hong Kong society and their issues -- all crammed into a single tenement building.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Wang Yu grows from a playful boy to a reformation hero against the Ching Dynasty, rising to protect his homeland and loved ones.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: After an inn-keeper's daughter witnesses a perverted rape, her true love must rescue her from the greater danger that threatens.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: The dying master of the powerful Poison Clan dispatches his last pupil, Yang Tieh, on a crucial mission to atone for the evil deeds of his clan disciples.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: This tragic tale depicts the life of Fang Pi Yu, a singer whose husband dies in his attempt to free her from her past, and whose father-in-law throws her out.

programme.title: Lady of Steel
programme.desc: Kung fu queen Cheng Pei-pei plays a swordswoman on a mission to find the bandits who killed her parents and save her country from foreign invaders.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: A man (Alexander Fu Sheng) must learn several unique martial arts styles and compete in three trials before he can marry his beloved.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: After a compulsive gambler's wife leaves him, he gets offered a beautiful ghost as his new wife.

programme.title: The Devil's Mirror
programme.desc: In Sun Chung's first film for the Shaw Brothers, a 'devil girl' turns one clan against another to acquire two powerful magic mirrors.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: According to this sex comedy, the true power behind China's many warlords were the prostitutes that these men would visit.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: A superhero (Danny Lee) must save the earth from legions of demons and monsters led by a blonde-haired Demon Princess.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: Lo Lieh finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: Michael Hui Kwun-Man makes a hilarious film debut as the nuttiest warlord of early 20th Century China! Also stars Lily Ho, Hu Chin and Tina Ti.

programme.title: A Taste of Cold Steel
programme.desc: It's a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword, as the Five Tigers take this adventure to the outer limits.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Lauded as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals of the 60s, this award-winning piece starring Linda Lin Dai as a dancer who finds romance with her boss's son.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Winner of Best Martial Arts Award at the 1978 Asian Film Festival, this piece is directed by Liu Chia-liang and features his brother, Gordon, as a martial arts master.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Ding, a con woman swindles a diamond ring off a rich man, but when it ends up in another man's hands, she now has to get it back.

programme.title: The Bloody Escape
programme.desc: Sun Chung teams up with real-life kungfu champion Chen Kuan-tai and martial arts choreographer Liu Chia-yung to tell the tale of a bandit with a conscience.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Lisa Lu stars as the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty in this film that is full of palace intrigues and power games.

programme.title: The Boxer From the Temple
programme.desc: A monk nicknamed 'The Kid' finds a barrage of gang fights on his hands after he meets a cruel bandit's son and an abused prostitute.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: A young couple's love is put to the test over a tumultuous period of Chinese history. Starring Linda Lin Dai, Kwan Shan.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: When a swordswoman falters in her attempt to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the world's sharpest blade, her protg continues her quest.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Director Li Han Hsiang adapts three erotic tales from Chinese classical literature for the silver screen. Starring Tien Lie, Hu Chin and Chen Ping.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: Ultimate combat is in the offing after King Eagle Chan Fei learns that Hung Ching Tien murdered their chief in a power struggle.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: This delightful action comedy featuring international favourite Alexander Fu Sheng presents a breathtaking showcase of wushu and wizardry.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: In this retelling of China's most popular romance, superstar Ivy Ling Po plays a scholar who tries to seduce a servant.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Real-life champion martial artist Chen Kuan-Tai plays a powerful role in this action-packed saga where he fights for his true love.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Secret of the Dirk
programme.desc: Lovely Ching Li and handsome Chang I unite as star-and-sword-crossed comrades who take on the vicious Black Tigers gang in a quest for hidden wealth.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: An extraordinary youth is determined to reunite with his goddess mother and unravel the mythical Lotus Lamp. Starring Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuan teams with star Ti Lung and famed novelist Chu Yu in the creation of this intriguing kung fu saga.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.

programme.title: The Protectors

programme.title: The Big Sting

programme.title: Duel of Fist

programme.title: Torrent of Desire

programme.desc: Yu-jun, an injured pianist, meets Jung-a in a college practice room, and they develop feelings for each other. He searches for her after she vanishes one day and discovers her secret.

programme.title: Hijack 1971
programme.desc: Detonation of an explosive device causes terror in the flight and pilot Gyu-Sik loses sight in one eye. Yong-dae who hatched the hijacking plot, threatens to take the plane to North Korea.

programme.title: The Old Woman With the Knife
programme.desc: A legendary assassin named Hornclaw is now aging. She faces declining health while mentoring a reckless apprentice, Bullfight, and confronting a deadly rival obsessed with her.

programme.title: Confession (2022)
programme.desc: A man who became a suspect in a closed-door murder seeks help from an attorney to prove him innocent. As they begin to piece the puzzle together, the truth slowly reverses.

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting
programme.desc: During the extradition to Korea, a group of dangerous criminals united to stage an escape from the floating prison.

programme.title: Boy in the Pool
programme.desc: Seok-young bumps into Woo-ju and they get closer after Woo-ju saves her from drowning. They lost touch after Woo-ju moves to Seoul to be a swimmer. Will they be able to meet again?

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Ui-gang, a retired hitman, reluctantly agrees to take care of a teen-aged girl Yoon-ji, but when she becomes involved with unsavory people, he shows up to rescue her and take her home.

programme.title: Life Is Beautiful
programme.desc: Se-yeon, devoted her entire life to her family, suddenly learns she is gravely ill. Now she is determined to live for herself more than ever and looks for her first love with the help of her husband.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Voice phishing victim infiltrates into the organisation's call center to recover the money, yet discovered another large scale scam ahead...

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

programme.title: Il Mare
programme.desc: A young woman from 1999 and a young man from 1997 begin a parallel-time love story separated by a span of two years when they start to receive each other's letters in the mailbox.

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: An undercover cop spends eight years to infiltrate South Korea's largest crime organization. When the head of the organization is killed, he becomes torn between his loyalties.

programme.title: Confession (2022)
programme.desc: A man who became a suspect in a closed-door murder seeks help from an attorney to prove him innocent. As they begin to piece the puzzle together, the truth slowly reverses.

programme.title: Fist & Furious
programme.desc: A former detective grants permission to a freelance video journalist to cover his revenge journey on a mob boss whom previously killed his partner during an investigation.

programme.title: Don't Go Too Far
programme.desc: While arguing on the division of their father's 2B inheritance, the eldest brother received a call to realize his son was kidnapped, and the ransom demanded was 2B...

programme.title: Honest Candidate 2
programme.desc: Joo Sang-sook, who failed to win the Seoul mayoral election by dropping the truth bomb on national television, is suddenly pulled into the spotlight again after rescuing a young man from drowning.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Ui-gang, a retired hitman, reluctantly agrees to take care of a teen-aged girl Yoon-ji, but when she becomes involved with unsavory people, he shows up to rescue her and take her home.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment
programme.desc: Ma Seok-Do investigates a drug-trafficking app, uncovers a link to an illegal organization. As Baek Chang-Gi terrorizes the gambling market, an alliance is formed to stop the threat.
